ns2:section.sectionText: Students working full-time need to register for this section (A). Students who wish to complete this course must seek approval from the Office of Engineering Graduate, Professional and Online Programs by completing the form located at http://engineering.illinois.edu/academics/graduate/eng-510-cpt-policy.html. International students on F1 visa must seek CPT approval at all levels to be eligible for a CPT experience. For information on the CPT process, please visit www.isss.illinois.edu/students/employment/f1cpt.html. S/U grading only. Range IV tuition and applicable fees apply.
